fieldValues.title: package-id-uniqueness compares UUIDs but not names
fieldValues.summary: The package-id-uniqueness check compares definition UUIDs and never canonical namespace/name/version, so two definitions with the same canonical name pass while being indistinguishable to anything resolving by name. Three real collisions were live in the corpus when the gap was found.
evidence: srs#584 records that package-id-uniqueness compares UUIDs only, so namespace/name@version collisions pass the check.
Three canonical identity collisions were resolved as a side effect of deleting the dead meta.* type set (srs#557, merged as srs#585) — they had passed every check until then.
fieldValues.body: The pattern is the recurring one in this repository: a motivating example gets fixed and the general enforcement is never built. Deleting the meta.* types removed the three collisions; nothing yet stops the fourth.
